name: Hiripoda Wessa
overview: A group of close friends from vastly different backgrounds step out of their sheltered lives into the harsh realities of the real world. As they navigate the unpredictable storms of early adulthood, unexpected romance, financial hardships, and deep personal betrayals begin to fracture their tight-knit circle. Together, they are forced to confront the true cost of their ambitions, family expectations, and intense societal pressures.
